items.name: theme
items.title: DUWOP theme
items.description: Our shared look: 15 themes (incl. a random palette roller), AMOLED, 6 effects and 10 width-matched fonts, switched by attributes on <html>.

items.name: appearance
items.title: DUWOP Appearance picker
items.description: Settings panel for theme, AMOLED, font and effects, with the palette dice. Shows only the themes the app allows.

items.name: boot
items.title: DUWOP boot script
items.description: Applies the saved look before first paint (no flash). Vite: add the script tag to index.html.

items.name: boot-astro
items.title: DUWOP boot for Astro
items.description: The boot script as an Astro component: put <DuwopBoot /> in the layout head.

items.name: popcorn
items.title: DUWOP popcorn rain
items.description: Opt-in effect: popcorn drifting down behind the page. Add <PopcornRain /> to the layout and a 'popcorn' entry to extraEffects in duwop-config.

items.name: gods
items.title: Glamours of the Gods
items.description: Add-on theme pack for websites: Olympus, Apollo, Athena, Poseidon, Hades and Ra, each with a light and a dark look, gilded Cinzel titles. Add extraThemes: gods in duwop-config.

items.name: command-center
items.title: Command Center
items.description: Add-on theme pack: Redline (true black, red glow), Night Drive (blue on night indigo) and Event Horizon (near-black, steel blue). Dark-only. Add extraThemes: commandCenter in duwop-config.

items.name: mode
items.title: DUWOP mode switch
items.description: Light / dark / system switch for sites that fix their own look (no theme picker). System follows the device live.

items.name: anymouse
items.title: Anymouse
items.description: Anonymous idea / bug / gripe box. <Anymouse /> opens a dialog and POSTs to /api/anymouse; sendAnymouse() in lib/anymouse-server.ts posts it to the app's Discord thread (ANYMOUSE_DISCORD_WEBHOOK + ANYMOUSE_THREAD_ID).

items.name: design-docs
items.title: DUWOP design docs
items.description: Starter PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md for Impeccable, pointing at DUWOP tokens.
